# Professional Academic Advising
Every Emory College student is assigned a professional OUE academic advisor for course planning, degree progress, challenges, and referrals.
# Finding an Advisor
Students can find their assigned advisor and schedule appointments in Navigate.
# Faculty Major Advising
After declaring a major, students also have a faculty major advisor for course selection, major degree planning, and graduate or professional pathways.
# Drop In Advising
OUE drop-in advising is offered by Zoom on weekdays from 2 to 4 during fall and spring, except university holidays; the page directs students to College Connect.
